{{Quote|Red Leader, this is Gold Leader. We're starting our attack run.|Jon "Dutch" Vander|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Jon "Dutch" Vander''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and an experienced [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He fought in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] as [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]], but was shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Loosen up!|Vander's last words before his death|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:Dutch_Vander_SWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Vander secures his helmet before prior to the Battle of Yavin.]]
A [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] nicknamed "Dutch", Jon Vander was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Renforra Base]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCGD" />

At [[Renforra]], Vander led [[Specter Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Specter Squadron]], flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing]], his preferred starfighter, under the designation "Specter 1". By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Vander proudly wore the emblem of Specter Squadron on his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="CCGD" /><ref name="CCGG1">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Gold 1}}</ref>

Some time before the Battle of Yavin, Vander served as [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] pilot for a Rebel [[Mission in the Belassar system|mission]] to the [[Belassar system/Legends|Belassar system]]. On their journey to the system, Vander told jokes to the Princess, who would later remember him as a friend.<ref name="CtE">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref>

Vander also participated in an [[Attack on the Kashyyyk outpost|attack]] on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supply outpost on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], with [[Hol Okand/Legends|Hol Okand]] as his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]].<ref name="CCGHO">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Hol Okand}}</ref>

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Vander had been transferred to the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where he was present for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna's]] briefing for the upcoming assault on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. During the briefing, Vander questioned the ability of the Alliance's [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] to destroy a target of the space station's size, and later gave Princess Leia a look of concern when Dodonna mentioned that the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust port]] was only two meters wide.<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:JonVander-XWM.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Vander pilots his Y-wing starfighter down the Death Star trench.]]
Despite his skepticism, Vander would fly his Y-wing, now designated [[Gold 1]], as [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]], leading his [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|squadron]] on one of the battle's first trench runs. Informing [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] of his attack, Vander led the run, followed by [[Gold Two/Legends|Gold Two]] [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]] and [[Gold Five/Legends|Gold Five]] [[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]]. Vander ordered his pilots to transfer all power to their Y-wings' front [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector screens]] as a defense against the Death Star's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets observed by Krail, and to activate their [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]]. When the turbolaser fire abruptly ceased, Krail advised his fellow pilots to stabilize their rear deflectors and watch for enemy fighters as [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1]] and his wingmen, flying [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], entered the trench. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] quickly shot down Tiree, causing Vander to lose his composure, ordering Krail to loosen formation. Krail refused, insisting they stay on target, while Vander in turn was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Darth Vader. Krail reported Tiree and Vander's deaths to Dreis, joining them shortly after.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jon_vander.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Vander during the Battle of Yavin]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], [[Angus MacInnes]] plays the pilot identified as Gold Leader. One of his wingmen, Gold Five, has a line mentioning squadron mates named Tiree and either Hutch or Dutch&mdash;the enunciation is unclear. Gold Five is referring to Gold Leader and Gold Two, but the film provides no way to determine which call sign is Tiree and which is Dutch/Hutch.<ref name="ANH" />

This pilot first appears in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]]. In this version of the Battle of Yavin, the Y-wing squadron is Red Squadron rather than Gold. Red Five, identified only as "Pops," speaks of a pilot named Dutch, but&mdash;as in the film&mdash;it is ambiguous whether he means Red Leader or Two.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>

The film's screenplay, as it appears in the original 1979 edition of ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]'', uses the Gold Squadron designation for the Y-wings. Here, too, Gold Five mentions Dutch, who could be either Gold Leader or Two.

The 1984 ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' clarified that Dutch was Gold Leader and Tiree was Gold Two.<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

In 1995, the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] was the first source to indicate that "Dutch" was a nickname and that his full name was Jon Vander.<ref name="CCGD" />

Most other sources over the years, such as the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', the [[Star Wars Trading Card Game]], an official action figure, and the current [[Memory bank/Legends|Databank]] entry, give this pilot's name or nickname as Dutch. However, the version of the screenplay in the 1997 book ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' gives his name as "'''Hutch'''." This variant was also used in the subtitles of the DVD of the film a decade later.

Vander's helmet prop — or one of a matching design — was later used by [[Derek Klivian/Legends|"Hobbie"]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> and by [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] as well as a different, unidentified pilot on [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] in the film.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
